_comment: WHALEHUNTERHEDGE v1.1 LONG sleeve — patient/consistent-whale conviction copy with TIERED sizing. Watches winners across four consistency x style tiers on Senpi Discover and mirrors their high-conviction LONG strikes (a NEW position whose marginUsed/accountValue clears convictionPct), sized by the whale's tier (see tagWeights). Pairs with the short sleeve on a SEPARATE wallet so conflicting same-asset positions coexist. Wide ride-the-whale DSL via runtime-long.yaml. Requires a USER-scoped SENPI_AUTH_TOKEN (discovery_* needs a user id). Set wallet/strategyId/chatId. Producer launched with WHALEHUNTER_LEG=long.
_v20_note: v2.0 COHORT-DIVERGENCE ENGINE (primary). Two cohorts by lifetime realized gains: smart = >= smartMinRealizedUsd ($1M), crowd = crowdMin..crowdMax ($10k-$100k). Each tick aggregates each cohort's NET positioning per coin (bias in [-1,+1]), tracks whether the smart cohort is ADDING daily (requireGrowing vs the cohort-ledger over ledgerLookbackDays), and on THIS sleeve's direction emits when the smart cohort is net-directional past biasThreshold AND growing, with crowdDivergenceMin (crowd net-opposite) as a confirmation booster. Score floor cohortMinScore. Sizes off marginPct..maxMarginPct scaled by score. The v1.x per-whale tier copy (tagWeights/convictionPct above) is RETAINED but OFF unless enableIndividualCopy=true. Requires a USER-scoped token (discovery_*). NOTE: ~1-day warmup — needs >=2 daily ledger snapshots before requireGrowing can pass.
_tier_note: tagWeights = the consistency x style sizing matrix. KEY '<CONSISTENCY>+<STYLE>', VALUE = tier weight that scales BOTH the base margin (marginPct) AND the per-position cap (maxMarginPct), so a higher tier always has a higher ceiling. Defaults: ELITE+PATIENT 1.0 (highest margin use), ELITE+TACTICAL 0.75, RELIABLE+PATIENT 0.50, RELIABLE+TACTICAL 0.40. ONLY these four combos are followed — every other tag pair (Streaky/Choppy consistency, Degen/Active style) is excluded entirely. Add a combo here to follow it; remove one to drop it. The pool is queried once per combo so each trader is tagged exactly.
_conviction_note: convictionPct = the whale's marginUsed / accountValue on the NEW position (capital at risk as a share of THEIR balance — the truest conviction read, not leverage-inflated notional). 0.25 = >=25% of their book. The gate is the SAME across tiers; the tier sets the SIZE, not whether to follow.
_sizing_note: MY margin = account_value * marginPct * tagWeight, then scaled by their conviction and pool consensus, capped at maxMarginPct * tagWeight. Conviction/consensus scale WITHIN a tier's range; the tier sets the range. Leverage is stdLeverage capped at maxLeverage then venue max (conviction shows in SIZE, never inherited leverage). No hardcoded $ amounts. Funding split across the two sleeves: default 50/50 (balanced long/short, no directional bias).
_persona: Tiered whale-conviction sniper — LONG sleeve. Follows consistent winners across four consistency x style tiers, strikes only their rare big-conviction LONG bets, sizes by tier, rides on a wide DSL. One of two sleeves of WhaleHunterHedge; pairs with the opposite sleeve on a separate wallet so conflicting same-asset positions coexist.
_v12_note: v1.2: convictionPct lowered 0.25->0.18 and poolSize 30->50 for activity (it sat 0 trades 3 days with a healthy 30-whale pool — no whale opened a >=25%-of-book new position). Producer now logs near-misses (new_dir_positions / max_conviction_seen / below_gate) so the binding constraint is visible. Still patient-whale conviction; tune convictionPct here.
